title: The Mirages of Torbridune
logline: On sand-scoured, epic Torbridune, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the sun shards and restore the Sun Shrine.
source_prompt: a small puzzle of sun shrines in the desert
player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Oasis Market and becomes the one who brings the Sun Shrine back to life.

key_locations.name: Oasis Market
key_locations.description: The start: palms and awnings around a spring.

key_locations.name: Nomad Camp
key_locations.description: Nomad Camp: a camp of Torbridune, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Scorpion Grotto
key_locations.description: Scorpion Grotto: a cave of Torbridune, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Sun Shrine
key_locations.description: The sun shrine at the heart of the story, standing beyond Oasis Market.

characters.name: Caravan Master Kai
characters.description: Waits in Oasis Market and knows why the Sun Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Bram the Guide
characters.description: Follows you from Oasis Market and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Piet the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Torbridune for anything shiny.

objectives_outline: Speak with Caravan Master Kai in Oasis Market
Recover the sun shards hidden across Nomad Camp, Scorpion Grotto
hazards: Sandstorm sweeping the exposed ground around the Sun Shrine
